checks.thresholds: Zero tolerance on sealed history: every comparator violation, unverified and review finding FAILS (including METADATA_CHANGED on a sealed bucket, REFERENCE_CHANGED, REFERENCE_ROWS_DECREASED, METADATA_COLUMNS_CHANGED, SPEC_VERSION_DIFFERS and every definition change) and a moved seal (SEALED_RANGE_DIFFERS) FAILS; only OPEN_SEASON_CHANGED and TABLE_ADDED are info. The manifest digests stable id columns as facts and reference tables whole, so any id change surfaces as a fail finding.

Schemas must match; a dropped table FAILS; a table added after FAILS unless it is one of the V2-added tables (award_proposals, award_proposal_decisions, derived_award_results, brownlow_eligibility_decisions, derived_award_projections), which must all be present after; fewer rows in a non-V2 table FAILS; more rows in a non-V2 table and any change in a V2-added table are info.
